run.objective: Deploy Nimbus Books to AWS Lambda with verified health

specialistFindings.summary: Hono v4 service on Node 22, port 8080, health at /health, ESM build output. CATALOG_MODE required; ADMIN_TOKEN optional but secret.
findings: Service name: @bobops/demo-service v1.0.0, framework Hono with @hono/node-server adapter
Port configurable via PORT env var, defaults to 8080
Health endpoint validates config and returns status (healthy/unhealthy)
CATALOG_MODE is a required env var; APP_VERSION and DEPLOY_PROVIDER are optional with defaults
ADMIN_TOKEN is optional but must be treated as a secret (header-based auth)
Entry point is src/server.ts; build output is ESM dist/server.mjs
Lambda entry point exists: src/lambda.ts with Hono AWS Lambda adapter

specialistFindings.summary: Recommends lambda (scale-to-zero) for AWS due to sporadic demo traffic, lightweight in-memory operations, and existing lambda.ts adapter. Estimated $0.20/month.
findings: Service already has src/lambda.ts with Hono AWS Lambda adapter — no adapter code needed
Four lightweight endpoints with sub-100ms latency; in-memory book catalog only
No database or external service dependencies — no connection warm-up penalty
Demo classification implies intermittent usage; scale-to-zero is cost-optimal
256MB memory profile sufficient for Node/Hono runtime
Expected ~100K requests/month fits AWS Lambda free tier (1M requests + 400K GB-seconds)

specialistFindings.summary: High-severity: weak x-admin-token header auth and ADMIN_TOKEN not in secret manager. Medium: hardcoded test secret 'admin-secret' in test fixtures, missing security headers, no rate limiting on admin endpoint.
findings: ADMIN_TOKEN must be stored in AWS Secrets Manager — never as plain env var
Admin endpoint uses custom x-admin-token header (weak); should use Authorization: Bearer
Test file contains hardcoded token 'admin-secret' — must not match production value
No CORS headers or security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) configured
No rate limiting on /api/admin/stats — brute-force possible
Error responses may leak missing env var names — should return generic 500

specialistFindings.summary: All deployment assets present (Dockerfile, .dockerignore, .ceignore, src/lambda.ts). Build and start scripts confirmed. Health endpoint present. No missing assets.
findings: Build script: esbuild with Node 22 target, ESM output to dist/server.mjs
Start script: node dist/server.mjs — runs compiled server
Test script: vitest run — unit tests available
Health endpoint: GET /health returns status with config validation
All deployment assets present: Dockerfile, .dockerignore, .ceignore, src/lambda.ts
Dockerfile uses multi-stage Alpine build with non-root 'node' user

risks.title: Weak Admin Token Authentication
risks.mitigation: Use bearer token (Authorization: Bearer) instead of custom x-admin-token header; enforce HTTPS; add rate limiting.

risks.title: Missing Sensitive Secret Management
risks.mitigation: Store ADMIN_TOKEN in AWS Secrets Manager; never in plain env or source code; rotate regularly.

risks.title: Hardcoded Test Secrets in Source
risks.mitigation: Extract test fixtures to separate file; scan with git-secrets or truffleHog before commits.

risks.title: Health endpoint returns 503 if required env vars missing
risks.mitigation: Deployment must set APP_VERSION and ADMIN_TOKEN before health checks pass; document in runbook.

plan.summary: Deploy Nimbus Books (Hono/Node 22, @bobops/demo-service) to AWS Lambda (scale-to-zero) in us-east-1. Service has pre-built lambda.ts adapter; all deployment assets are present. ADMIN_TOKEN delivered via secret ref.

targets.architectureRationale: Nimbus Books is a lightweight Hono demo service with four in-memory endpoints and sub-100ms latency, exhibiting sporadic demo traffic patterns that make scale-to-zero Lambda ideal for cost efficiency; the service already ships a src/lambda.ts Hono AWS Lambda adapter requiring no additional cold-start mitigation.

risks.title: Weak Admin Token Authentication
risks.mitigation: ADMIN_TOKEN delivered via AWS Secrets Manager secret ref; x-admin-token header auth is demo-grade — upgrade to Authorization: Bearer before production.

risks.title: ADMIN_TOKEN must be in Secrets Manager
risks.mitigation: Listed in secretRefs; must be created in AWS Secrets Manager as 'ADMIN_TOKEN' before deployment executes.

risks.title: Health returns 503 if required env vars missing
risks.mitigation: CATALOG_MODE, APP_VERSION, and ADMIN_TOKEN must all be set; plan env and secretRefs cover this requirement.

plan.rollbackStrategy: Invoke devops_propose_remediation with type=rollback to revert to the previous Lambda revision via Lambda version alias swap.
approvalGates: Human approval in Control Center before execution
